local function fadeIn(frame)
	frame.Visible = true
	local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = 0})
	tween:Play()
end

-- دالة Tween للاختفاء
local function fadeOut(frame, callback)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		frame.Visible = false
		if callback then callback() end
	end)
	tween:Play()
end
